note: vid-title eval, synced to the current skill contract (title written to piece.md; no titles.md artifact). Uses Billy's real banks (pattern-bank.md, title-bank.md, power-words-bank.md under fixtures/) and the frozen billy brain-dumps (input_stage/{slug}/brain-dump.md, whose '### Verifiable specifics (lock list)' section is the lock-list ground truth). The upstream framed piece.md per slug is suite-local (suite_fixtures/{slug}/piece.md) because it must carry the current vid-framing schema (selected_angle, core_payoff in frontmatter); the shared billy stage piece.md files predate that schema. The test runner drives the CURRENT vid-title skill once per case: load the suite-local piece.md, the billy brain-dump.md, creator-foundation.md, packaging-system.md, then shop pattern-bank.md + title-bank.md, write with power-words-bank.md + BENS, run the checklist, present with receipts, lock. Output contract per case (written by the test runner to outputs/case_NN/): exactly two files. (1) piece.md: the suite-local upstream piece with ONLY two changes, the title: frontmatter field set to the locked title and last_updated: bumped to the run date; every other frontmatter field and the body preserved verbatim. (2) transcript.md: the full working trace, which must contain these parseable sections: '## Lock list' (bullets grounded in brain-dump.md; the list the titles were allowed to use), '## Wide pass' (20 or more numbered candidates, the kill-rate floor; most of these must die), a kill-pass note (what died and why), '## Options' (3 to 5 proven structure groups plus exactly one wildcard group; each proven group is a '### <structure name>' heading with ONE receipt line of the form receipt: "<source outlier title>" (@channel, <N.Nx>) and 1 to 2 numbered candidate lines of the form N. "Title text"  <BENS letters>  (<char count>), e.g. 1. "Meal Prep Mistakes That Keep You Ordering Takeout"  B+N  (48); the wildcard group heading contains the word 'wildcard', carries NO receipt line, and holds 1 to 2 flagged swings), '## Recommendation' (names one presented candidate as the recommendation with its reason), and a lock confirmation. Total presented survivors (proven + wildcard) must be 6 to 10. Every receipt must cite a REAL outlier from the banks: the quoted title must appear in pattern-bank.md or title-bank.md, the @handle must appear in the banks, and when the quoted title sits on a pattern-bank table row the cited multiplier must match that row's xMed. Every presented candidate and the locked title must be <= 55 characters, carry at least one BENS letter, contain no colon or pipe, no em-dash, no banned word, no AI-default opener ('the truth about', 'everything you need to know', 'why you should', 'the ultimate guide to', 'discover the secret'), and only lock-list specifics (for case_02 the lock list has NO numbers: any digit in any presented or locked title fails). The locked title in piece.md must be one of the presented candidates. transcript.md is never scanned for brand rules or fabrication as a whole (it legitimately echoes the creator and cites real bank titles); all title-level gates are scoped to the extracted presented-candidate and locked-title strings.
